command: flock /tmp/sqll-machine.lock uv run --frozen --project harness python scripts/s3/speed_profile.py time --scratch $SCRATCH

method.text: harness/bench.md (the S2 baseline method): the CI image in docker, a new container for each session, serial, no network, no other load; the full profile; the tools run in turn for each repeat (timer.run_in_turn). Session 1 is the controlled session; sessions 2 to 5 measure the noise. After the timed runs of session 1, each sqll input runs 5 times with --timings.
method.machine_lock: the command ran under flock /tmp/sqll-machine.lock (PROCESS.md, rule 7)
method.load_rule: each session starts when the 1-minute load average is below 0.3; after it, the 5-minute load average must be at most 1.5
